subject: [RFC PATCH 14/57] mm/collapse: fault the sources in before the freeze

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the collapse functionality in the Linux kernel to fault in pages before freezing them. It ensures that each candidate slot is either a hole, the zero page, or an exclusively owned present page. The patch walks through each candidate slot and lets the fault path handle any necessary actions, such as unsharing pages shared with fork children or reading back swap entries. If a page cannot be faulted in after multiple attempts, it is left to the freeze function to refuse it. The patch also introduces a new retry mechanism for swap-in faults below the PMD order and reports dropped locks accordingly.
